resource: Lefff 3.4 extensional morphology (.mlex), filtered target-lemma extract
officialDownloadStatus: The legacy GForge download returned HTTP 403 at capture time.
selection: B1 rows with tag=VER in Resources/FleLex_TT_Beacco.tsv, plus aller/avoir/être; byte-identical duplicate records removed while preserving source order.
targetLemmaExclusion: The tagged verb hier is absent from the Lefff verb section and has a transparent regular -ier paradigm in verb_morphology_overrides.json; it is not silently treated as the adverb hier.

citation: Sagot, Benoît (2010). The Lefff, a freely available and large-coverage morphological and syntactic lexicon for French. LREC 2010.
